tools.name: merge_pdfs
tools.description: Merge multiple PDF files into one, in the order given. Returns the merged PDF as base64.

tools.name: split_pdf
tools.description: Split a PDF into parts. Provide ranges like "1-3, 5, 8-10" (each comma group becomes one output PDF), or omit ranges to get every page as its own PDF. Returns base64 files.

tools.name: extract_pages
tools.description: Extract the given pages into a new PDF (original order). Returns base64.

tools.name: remove_pages
tools.description: Delete the given pages from a PDF. Returns the remaining document as base64.

tools.name: rotate_pdf
tools.description: Rotate pages clockwise by 90, 180, or 270 degrees. Rotates all pages unless a page list is given. Returns base64.

tools.name: watermark_pdf
tools.description: Stamp a diagonal text watermark (e.g. "CONFIDENTIAL", "DRAFT") across every page. Returns base64.

tools.name: add_page_numbers
tools.description: Stamp page numbers onto every page of a PDF. Returns base64.

tools.name: get_pdf_metadata
tools.description: Read a PDF's document properties (title, author, subject, keywords, creator, producer, dates, page count).

tools.name: set_pdf_metadata
tools.description: Rewrite a PDF's document properties. Pass empty strings to strip identifying metadata before sharing. Returns base64.

tools.name: flatten_pdf
tools.description: Flatten fillable form fields into permanent page content so answers can't be edited. Returns base64.
